remarks: Experience luxury living in this sun-drenched corner unit at Park Tower, a pet-friendly high-rise in the heart of vibrant downtown Stamford. Soaring ceilings and floor-to-ceiling windows flood the space with natural light and offer sweeping views of the city, and of Mill River Park - cherry blossoms in spring, colorful fall foliage, winter ice skating, and summer concerts and fitness classes right outside your door.  The spacious open layout features a modern kitchen with a large island and seating, granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and rich wood flooring throughout. Two bedrooms each include an en-suite bath, along with a powder room for guests and convenient in-unit laundry. Garage parking is available.   Enjoy the many amenities, including a rooftop terrace with panoramic views of Long Island Sound and Manhattan, a year-round indoor pool, fitness center, stylish resident lounge, and 24/7 concierge service. A complimentary shuttle takes you to the Metro North station for a 52-minute express ride to NYC. This is downtown Stamford living at its finest.
